sanitization: No host or user identifiers present. Timestamps and rule data unmodified.

environment.endpoint: WSL2 Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS, agent 001, group linux

logtest.first_run: FAILED - rule used <same_field>srcuser</same_field>, which never matches static fields; 10 events produced only 5557
logtest.fix: <same_srcuser />; validator now rejects <same_field> on static fields (regression test added)
logtest.second_run: PASSED positive (6 failures, same user -> 100100) and negative (6 failures across 3 users -> no 100100)

e2e.procedure: Create comment-only /etc/sudoers.d/aegis-e2e (visudo -c OK), never-enabled /etc/systemd/system/aegis-e2e.service, and group aegis-e2e-grp; wait 10 s; remove all

e2e.finding: Real-time FIM watches on individual files are lost after an atomic replace (write temp + rename). A second groupadd/groupdel produced 0 alerts.
e2e.fix: Monitor /etc and sensitive subdirectories as directories (deployment/wazuh/agent-groups/linux/agent.conf)
e2e.procedure: groupadd/groupdel aegis-e2e-r1, then aegis-e2e-r2 (4 atomic replacements of /etc/group)

limitations: No actor attribution (real-time mode; kernel audit unavailable on WSL2).
Watching /etc in real time increases event volume; measured in Phase 7.
